rationale: Both build a round on chasing one contested flag: Flagrush designs booster-driven capture-the-flag with bases and capture scoring; Flag Tag runs perpetual 5-minute contested-flag keep-away scored by server-credited seconds carried. Flag Tag was deployed 2026-07-05, before this document was drafted, and implements none of its specific mechanics — no bases, no capture scoring, no booster pads.
basis: This program's own reading of the flagrush-v1 document body against Flag Tag's deployment-entity description and observed flag-carry mechanics — not a fact either row carries.
